vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: temporal-cortex-scheduling
Version: 0.9.1

The temporal-cortex-scheduling skill provides a comprehensive set of tools for managing Google, Outlook, and CalDAV calendars. It utilizes a local MCP server (a Rust binary distributed via npm) with well-documented security practices, including SHA256 checksum verification during installation and a Two-Phase Commit protocol for booking safety. The skill stores OAuth credentials locally at ~/.config/temporal-cortex/ and includes explicit instructions for the AI agent to seek user confirmation before performing write operations or sending proposals. No evidence of malicious intent, unauthorized data exfiltration, or harmful prompt injection was found.
